name: tt-intellisense
description: Language support for Perl Template Toolkit: highlighting, navigation, diagnostics and variable completion.

ttIntellisense.includePath.markdownDescription: Additional directories searched when resolving `INCLUDE`, `PROCESS`, `INSERT` and `WRAPPER` targets, mirroring Template Toolkit's `INCLUDE_PATH`. Relative paths resolve against each workspace folder. The directory of the file containing the reference is always searched first.

ttIntellisense.diagnostics.structural.markdownDescription: Report structural problems: unbalanced `END`, unclosed blocks, unterminated tags, misplaced `ELSE`/`CASE`/`CATCH`, and mistyped directive keywords.

ttIntellisense.schema.dumpDirectory.markdownDescription:
Where runtime stash dumps live. Accepts one path or a list.

A relative path is resolved against each workspace folder. An **absolute path**, or one starting `~`, is used as given — which is how one dump can serve every project instead of being copied into each. A dump kept outside any repository also cannot be committed by accident.

Example: `["~/.tt-schema", ".tt-schema"]` reads a shared dump plus a project-local one.

JSON dumps are preferred because they express lists; the ASCII tree format is also read. **Keep dumps out of version control** — they capture real values from real renders and routinely contain credentials.

ttIntellisense.schema.curatedFile.markdownDescription: Curated schema file mapping dotted paths to `description` and `type`, overriding what dumps and mining supply. Accepts one path or a list, resolved the same way as `#ttIntellisense.schema.dumpDirectory#`.

ttIntellisense.embedded.enabled.markdownDescription: Forward completion and hover to the built-in HTML and CSS language services when the cursor is outside a Template Toolkit directive. Diagnostics are never forwarded: a branching template does not project to well-formed HTML.

ttIntellisense.autoClosingTags.markdownDescription: Insert the matching closing tag when you type `>` or `/` in HTML. Never fires inside a Template Toolkit directive.
